title: Space Pets
kdp_subtitle: Puppies, Kittens and Robots in Outer Space to Color, with Mazes, Counting and Dot-to-Dot for Kids Ages 4-8
back_lines: Puppies, kittens and robots are zooming past planets
and stars. Where will they fly next?
description:
Puppies and kittens are blasting off to space!

Space Pets is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Space puppies, kittens, bunnies, robots and a friendly dragon
  • Rockets, planets, moons and shining stars
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
A fun gift for kids who love pets, rockets and the stars.
